validated_objective: Release QIF v0.6.44 with an executable, auditable, domain-general cross-judge dependency and correlation lifecycle.
scope: reusable judge dependency policy and one-to-one judgment dependency profiles
cross-judge panel assessment preserving agreement, dissent, abstention, shared dependencies, and adjudication provenance
deterministic aggregate correlation assessment and governance triggers
schema, verifier, example, retained fixtures, plain-language docs, roadmap, AOF evidence, tag, and GitHub release
constraints: No UI, external integration, hidden reasoning collection, automatic actor selection, ranking, replacement, authorization, policy mutation, or blame assignment
No claim that majority, unanimity, confidence, adjudication, or low observed disagreement proves truth, quality, competence, independence, optimality, selection, authorization, or authority
expected_outcomes: Humans and AI can reproduce whether cross-judge agreement is materially dependent and whether dissent and abstention remain visible.
Dependent consensus, unverified dependency evidence, and insufficient panels become explicit governance work before reliance.
